# PublishRank SEO for WordPress
> PublishRank SEO 2.25.1 is a production-ready, free and open-source WordPress SEO plugin for businesses, stores, service providers, creators, publishers and websites of every kind. It includes site metadata, connected schema, XML and News sitemaps, Local SEO, WooCommerce SEO, redirects, 404 monitoring, analytics, Traffic Guard, Access Shield, FAQ collections, SEO Inspector, Source Directory and optional editorial workflows. All features have been tested on real websites by the PublishRank Community, with no errors reported. The delivery report separately records 409 checks with zero failures on WordPress 7.1.4, PHP 8.3.36 and SQLite, and documents the scope of that run. SEO metadata and structured data do not guarantee rankings or rich results.
